messages:
Elliot Price: Need final pass today on checklist copy + linking policy for the “Production launch” steps. Specifically: quotas/budget alerts + model pinning/fallback. Goal: Console step text matches docs, and links are stable.

Wei Chen: +1. I have PR-912 open w/ the checklist page + per-step anchors. Just want to lock wording so I can update the canonical template + the quickstart sections.

Jean-Paul Laurent: Sharing current draft step names (production launch section):
1) “Set quotas and budget alerts”
2) “Pin a model version”
3) “Configure fallback policy”
4) “Add basic observability hooks”

Kenji Nakamura: From Console constraints: step title max ~38 chars before wrapping weird in the drawer. Body copy max ~140-ish chars before it feels dense.

Elliot Price: Great. Proposal: keep titles action-oriented. For linking policy: each step gets ONE canonical docs link (not a repo link), with optional “example” secondary link only if we can guarantee it won’t churn.

Wei Chen: On links: I’d like to do stable URLs under /docs/guides/production-launch/* and then we can 301 anything old. Avoid linking to “/blog/” or “/changelog/”.

Marissa Cole: Console deep links will go to Console pages (budgets, quotas, models). External link should be Learn more. If docs URL changes we’re in trouble, so +1 stable + redirects.

Nikhil Sharma: +1 and let’s make sure the link is “what to do” not “concepts”. We keep getting tickets where people don’t understand what setting quotas actually does.

Dev Patel: Support asks: please call out the “429 surprise” explicitly (even in one sentence). That’s a top reason folks think prod is broken.

Priya Shah: + also confusion between “rate limits” vs “quotas/budgets”. If we can use the same terms everywhere, it’ll reduce back-and-forth.

Jean-Paul Laurent: Copy attempt for quotas step:
Title: “Set quotas & budget alerts”
Body: “Avoid 429s + cost surprises. Set project quota and configure budget alerts before go-live.”

Kenji Nakamura: Title length looks okay. Body is a bit long but probably fits. Maybe shorten: “Avoid 429s + cost surprises. Set quota and budget alerts before go-live.”

Elliot Price: 👍 on that. Terminology check: do we say “quota” or “rate limit” here?

Nikhil Sharma: The UI label is “Quotas” in Console, but 429s are rate-limits. I’d keep “quota” in title and mention 429 in body.

Wei Chen: For docs page name: “Quotas, rate limits, and budget alerts” (H2 sections for each). That solves confusion. Console step still concise.

Monica Patel: Also want a quick callout: “budgets do not block traffic, they alert” (we get ‘why did my budget stop requests’).

Wei Chen: Yep, can put a single line in docs + in the step drawer. In step body we might not have room.

Elliot Price: Linking policy decision draft (please react):
- Each checklist step includes exactly one “Learn more” link to a canonical docs URL owned by Docs.
- Console can include additional *Console* deep links (internal routing) but not external repo links.
- If we need examples, docs page hosts them (or links to pinned commit/tag) so Console link stays stable.
- Docs agrees to maintain redirects for any moved pages.

Kenji Nakamura: :thumbsup:

Marissa Cole: :thumbsup: (also please don’t deep link to query params that change by org/region)

Ibrahim Khan: Re model pinning wording: can we make it clear pinning prevents silent changes? That’s the point for prod.

Jean-Paul Laurent: Draft for model pinning:
Title: “Pin a model version”
Body: “Prevent unexpected behavior changes. Pin the model + version you validated in staging.”

Nikhil Sharma: Good. Maybe “validated” vs “tested” is fine.

Dev Patel: Support note: add “avoid regressions” language. Customers understand that.

Wei Chen: Docs page for that would be /docs/guides/production-launch/model-pinning (includes: how to pick version, rollout notes, and how to see deprecation notices).

Elliot Price: For fallback policy step: do we want that in MVP checklist? (I know it’s in PRD, but some folks said too advanced.)

Marissa Cole: It’s in MVP but can be “recommended” (not blocking completion). Console supports “Recommended” grouping. We should still write copy.

Jean-Paul Laurent: Draft fallback copy:
Title: “Configure fallback policy”
Body: “Keep your app online during capacity issues. Set a compatible fallback model + region.”

Kenji Nakamura: Fits. We should avoid “capacity issues” sounding scary; but it’s accurate.

Priya Shah: Please keep it. We get tickets like “requests failing intermittently” and fallback would have prevented the escalation.

Wei Chen: Link target: /docs/guides/production-launch/fallback-and-retries (this would also include client retry patterns, but that’s maybe a separate step already).

Monica Patel: I’d prefer fallback doc doesn’t also become the “retries” canonical page. SDK guidance for retries is its own step earlier. Maybe name it /fallback-policy and have a separate /retries-timeouts.

Elliot Price: Agree. Linking policy: each step maps 1:1 to a docs page where possible. Otherwise the step links to the relevant section anchor on the checklist page.

Wei Chen: Works. I’ll create:
- /docs/guides/production-launch/quotas-rate-limits-budgets
- /docs/guides/production-launch/model-pinning
- /docs/guides/production-launch/fallback-policy
Then the master checklist page can summarize and link out.

Elliot Price: Any objections to “budget alerts” vs “budget notifications”? Console uses “Budgets” but the alerting is what they do.

Marissa Cole: Keep “budget alerts” in text; it’s clearer. Console page is “Budgets” but we can deep link there.

Dev Patel: +1. In support we say “budget alerts”.

Wei Chen: Cool. I’ll update PR-912 copy + add redirects stub. Also will update the step-to-docs link map (the GDrive table) to reflect the final URLs.

Elliot Price: Final copy set (unless last-minute nits):
- Step title: “Set quotas & budget alerts”
  Body: “Avoid 429s + cost surprises. Set quota and budget alerts before go-live.”
  Learn more: /docs/guides/production-launch/quotas-rate-limits-budgets
- Step title: “Pin a model version”
  Body: “Prevent regressions. Pin the model + version you tested in staging.”
  Learn more: /docs/guides/production-launch/model-pinning
- Step title: “Configure fallback policy” (Recommended)
  Body: “Stay online during capacity issues. Set a compatible fallback model + region.”
  Learn more: /docs/guides/production-launch/fallback-policy
React ✅ if good.

Kenji Nakamura: ✅

Nikhil Sharma: ✅

Marissa Cole: ✅

Monica Patel: ✅

Dev Patel: ✅

Priya Shah: ✅

Wei Chen: ✅ will land updates today and ping when PR is ready for review.
